claims.claim: A burst of ~3,000 downloads ran interleaved on the same event loop that serves /tasks, which is why those requests slowed to seconds
claims.about: node-express (the team's Express API with in-process PDF/chart rendering)
claims.why: The benchmark has no test that mixes 400 ms CPU-bound chart renders with other Express endpoints, so the 'slowed to seconds' latency figure can't be checked against it.
